crossRefs.note: David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night on the ground.
Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of…
Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
Then David took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.
David said to Joab, and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth…

translations.web: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
translations.bsb: Then the king stood up, tore his clothes, and lay down on the ground. And all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
translations.kjv: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
translations.asv: Then the king arose, and rent his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
